query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS monthlyStockSnapshot (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  companyId INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  year INT NOT NULL,
  month INT NOT NULL,
  competenceMonth VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL,
  categoryId INT,
  categoryName VARCHAR(200),
  totalItems INT DEFAULT 0,
  totalCost DECIMAL(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
  snapshotDate TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  capturedBy VARCHAR(64),
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY monthlyStockSnapshot_month_cat (companyId, year, month, categoryId)
);
